say: Ye call training ke liye record ki jaa rahi hai. Aapki chaar hazaar do sau rupaye ki EMI paanch tareekh ko bank se kat nahi payi, kya hua tha?
speak: ये call training के लिए record की जा रही है। आपकी चार हज़ार दो सौ रुपये की EMI पाँच तारीख़ को bank से कट नहीं पाई, क्या हुआ था?

checks.label: Confirmed it was the borrower before saying anything about the loan
No threats, shaming, legal action, or mention of family or employer
Never said a payment had arrived or 'ho gaya' without system confirmation
Any part payment offered was at least the minimum (50% of the EMI)
At most one payment link was sent
No promises about waivers, calls stopping, or credit-record outcomes
Stated only the customer facts and policy notes given; no invented numbers or reasons
Dates and amounts read back correctly against what the borrower said
One question at a time, short turns, polite register (aap, ji)
Ended with a clear next step (amount, date, how) or a polite close

review.summary: Meera confirmed she was speaking to Ujjwal Goel, then told him about the recording and asked why the ₹4,200 EMI due on the 5th had bounced. The transcript ends there, with no reason, date or amount from the borrower, so no payment commitment was made.
review.nextStep: Follow up with the borrower to learn why the EMI bounced and get a payment date, since the call ended before any plan was agreed.
